cases.name: Katie Mae Kellen
cases.about: She worked at Saint Luke's Hospital of Kansas City. Her obituary said, "Katie worked for many years as a CNA where she enjoyed taking care of others. Katie loved spending time with her family, listening to music, relaxing by the lake, and helping others."
cases.narrative: On 7/8/2021, her mother found her body.
